identity.description: An attacker uses fodhelper.exe to bypass UAC by modifying registry keys, then executes a malicious payload. Cortex should detect the unusual registry modification and execution of fodhelper.exe with elevated privileges.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Fodhelper UAC Bypass Registry Modification
biocs.description: Detection of registry modifications targeting CLSID keys used by fodhelper.exe for UAC bypass
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.REGISTRY
| filter action_file_path contains 'HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID'
| filter action_file_path contains 'InprocServer32'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'

abiocs.name: Fodhelper.exe Unusual Execution with Registry Modification
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation detecting fodhelper.exe execution following suspicious registry modification
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'fodhelper.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID'
abiocs.causality_anchor: registry modification followed by fodhelper.exe execution

xql_queries.name: Fodhelper UAC Bypass Registry Access
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.REGISTRY
| filter action_file_path contains 'HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID'
| filter action_file_path contains 'InprocServer32'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_file_path
